s1.syndrome_frame: A painful polypoid mass on the gingiva with bone resorption and atypical cells
salient_findings: 10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion covered by a whitish pseudomembrane
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
key_facts: 69-year-old Japanese man
Pain on the left lower gingiva
10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
History of chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
No tobacco or alcohol use
Trismus present
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion covered by a whitish pseudomembrane
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
Enhancing soft-tissue mass with irregular mandibular bone destruction on contrast-enhanced CT
Biopsy specimen showed loose granulation tissue with scattered atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells
Spindle cells had basophilic cytoplasm, bizarre nuclei, and atypical mitoses
Immunohistochemical staining revealed spindle cells positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68

differentials: Squamous cell carcinoma with sarcomatoid features
per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma with sarcomatoid features

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of squamous cell carcinoma and presence of atypical spindle cells

shortlist.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical spindle cells and immunohistochemical staining positive for p63 and p53

shortlist.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells, and immunohistochemical staining positive for vimentin and CD68

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells, and high Ki-67 labeling index

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical spindle cells with basophilic cytoplasm and immunohistochemical staining positive for α-smooth muscle actin

raw.rationale: The patient's history of squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa and the presence of atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells with positive staining for p63, a marker often associated with squamous cell carcinoma, support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence distinguishing it from sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: Now considered a subtype of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, and the presence of p63 positivity points more towards a squamous cell origin

rejected.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of p63 and the patient's history of squamous cell carcinoma suggest a more specific diagnosis of sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The immunohistochemical profile does not specifically support smooth muscle differentiation as seen in leiomyosarcoma
